Urban Concierge - Bay Area

Saturday Nov 14 – Monday Nov 16, 2026 · Snapshot compiled Fri Nov 13, 2026, 10:30 pm PT (Urban Concierge - Bay Area)

What changed since the last brief (Sun Nov 8): The window moved to Sat–Mon. Rain is now forecast for Sunday, and a High Surf Warning and Coastal Flood Advisory are up. The Monday Warriors game I listed last time is not a Chase Center game this week: the Warriors play Pelicans in New Orleans on Nov 16. BART has no Green Line service this weekend.

What's on (each confirmed on an official page)

Only four events held up on official pages this run. I dropped the Gautier Capuçon recital (the page I found was the 2025 date), and I did not list the SF Tea Festival because the organizer says Nov 14–15 is sold out.

1) SF Symphony: Prokofiev's Romeo and Juliet, Sat Nov 14, 7:30 pm and Sun Nov 15, 2 pm. Davies Symphony Hall, 201 Van Ness Ave. Marie Jacquot makes her Orchestral Series debut. Program: Holmès's Andromède, Respighi's Concerto gregoriano with violinist Sayaka Shoji, and selections from Prokofiev's Romeo and Juliet. Prices are on the ticket page (a partner listing shows $50–$185).
https://www.sfsymphony.org/Calendar/This-Month · programming release: http://www.sfsymphony.org/getmedia/9af39ed5-82f5-429c-9300-b3b79bcc303c/November-2026-SF-Symphony-programs.pdf

2) Renegade Craft Fair, Winter Edition: Sat Nov 14 and Sun Nov 15, 11 am–5 pm. Fort Mason Center Festival Pavilion, 2 Marina Blvd. 250+ curated artists. A third-party listing says entry is free with a suggested $5 contribution; the organizer page doesn't state that in what I read.
https://www.renegadecraft.com/event/san-francisco-winter/

3) Fort Mason Farmers Market: Sun Nov 15, 9:30 am–1:30 pm. Fort Mason Center. Free, rain or shine, 50+ farmers and food purveyors.
https://fortmason.org/event/sunday-farmers-market/2026-11-15/

4) ZooLights: open Sat Nov 14 (5:30–10 pm) and Sun Nov 15 (5:30–9 pm); closed Mon and Tue. San Francisco Zoo. Over one million lights across 14 zones. Adults $30, children 2–11 $21; members $3 off. Last ticket entry 9 pm Sat, 8 pm Sun. Sunday is forecast to be rainy.
https://www.sfzoo.org/zoolights/

Weather and alerts

NWS SF (updated 8:49 pm PST Fri): Tonight mostly cloudy, 30% chance of rain 1–2 am, low 53 · Sat cloudy then mostly sunny, high 65 · Sat night cloudy, low 55, gusts to 21 mph · Sun rain mainly after 11 am (100%), high 64, ¼–½ inch, gusts to 23 mph · Sun night rain mainly before 10 pm, low 52 · Mon 30% chance of light rain, mostly sunny, high 62 · Mon night mostly clear, low 49 · Tue sunny, 61, rain after 10 pm.
Advisories: the forecast page shows a High Surf Warning and a Coastal Flood Advisory. The api.weather.gov alerts feed returned an error this run, so I could not read the timing or details. Stay off rocks and jetties.
Source: https://forecast.weather.gov/MapClick.php?lat=37.7749&lon=-122.4194&unit=0&lg=english&FcstType=text&TextType=1

Road closures

  • SB I-280 connector to SB US-101, San Francisco: closed overnight Fri Nov 13, 11 pm to Sat Nov 14, 6 am. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-13-sf-overnight-closure
  • WB I-580 Richmond-San Rafael Bridge: full closure Sat Nov 14, 11 pm to Sun Nov 15, 8 am (lane closures from 7 pm, bike path closes 9 pm). https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-10-rsr-bridge-closure
  • EB I-80 Bay Bridge: one lane open Sun–Thu 10 pm–7 am through mid-December (carried from Nov 8 Caltrans notice). https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-05-i80-sfobb-lane-closures
  • Live conditions: https://quickmap.dot.ca.gov and 511.org (511 not re-read this run).

Where to eat

No Yelp ratings (Yelp blocks automated loads). Same three picks as Nov 8, carried from that brief; hours were not re-checked this run, so confirm before going.

Zuni Café, Hayes Valley (1658 Market St). Daily-changing menu of French, Italian and Mediterranean cooking; roast chicken for two and the Zuni Caesar are signatures. Closed Monday per its site last check. Walkable to Davies. (415) 552-2522. https://zunicafe.com/

Kin Khao, Union Square (55 Cyril Magnin St). Michelin One Star Thai/Californian from Chef Pim Techamuanvivit. https://www.kinkhao.com/ · https://guide.michelin.com/ie/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/kin-khao

Tadich Grill, Financial District (240 California St). Open since 1849; mesquite-grilled seafood and classic cocktails. Closed Sunday per its site last check. https://www.tadichgrill.com/

Muni and cable cars (carried from Nov 8): $2.85 single ride with Clipper or tap-to-pay, good 120 min. Day pass $5.70. Cable car $9.00. Visitor Passports $15 / $35 / $47. Youth 18 and under ride free (not cable cars). https://www.sfmta.com/getting-around/muni/fares. Muni service alerts page was not reachable this run; check https://www.sfmta.com/ for current detours.

BART (live check 10 pm Fri):

  • Sat Nov 14 and Sun Nov 15: no Green Line; free buses replace trains between 24th St Mission and Daly City (train control work). All trains shift up to 3 minutes.
  • Sat night into Sun morning: ~9-minute average waits on BART to OAK service.
  • Powell St. entrance at 4th and Market closes Nov 16 – Dec 18.
  • Yellow Line single-tracking in Contra Costa late-night on Nov 16 and Nov 17–18. Transbay Tube single-tracking next on Nov 21.
    https://www.bart.gov/schedules/advisories

Bikes and scooters (carried): Lyft Bike / Bay Wheels $1 unlock + $0.19/min classic, $0.49/min ebike; day pass $15. Rain Sunday. https://www.lyft.com/bikes/bay-wheels/pricing

SFO (carried): Rental Car Center via AirTrain Blue Line; Lyft/Uber on Level 5 of the Domestic Garage. https://www.flysfo.com/passengers/ground-transportation

Where to stay

Civic Center/Hayes Valley is close to Davies and Zuni. Union Square has the most hotels and best transit, handy with the BART Green Line bus bridge this weekend. The Marina/Cow Hollow side suits Fort Mason. https://www.sftravel.com/neighborhoods

Own site: menus change daily, drawing on French, Italian and Mediterranean cooking with seasonal, organic ingredients; classics include house-cured anchovies, the Zuni Caesar and roast chicken for two. James Beard "Outstanding Restaurant" (2003). Dinner Tue–Sun 5–9:30 pm, lunch Fri–Sun 11 am–3 pm, closed Monday. Walkable to Davies for Friday's concert. (415) 552-2522. https://zunicafe.com/

Kin Khao, Union Square, SF (55 Cyril Magnin St, in Parc 55). Michelin Guide One Star, Thai/Californian: Chef Pim Techamuanvivit's layered, produce-driven Thai cooking, such as hor mok curry mousse and a green curry with slow-cooked local rabbit; some dishes are very spicy. Own site: California's oldest continuously run restaurant (since 1849), known for mesquite-grilled seafood, casseroles and stews, and classic cocktails; reservations taken, walk-ins welcome, counter seats for one or two.
